body:
Real, no-sudo AVR toolchain (apt-get download gcc-avr/avr-libc/avrdude/binutils-avr/libftdi1/libhidapi-libusb0/libusb-0.1-4, dpkg -x into ~/.local/opt/avr-toolchain). New examples/avr/{blink.prn,blink_main.c,parena_runtime.h} (PARENA emits pure Bool-toggle decision logic, hand-written AVR host wires DDRB/PORTB registers). New Makefile avr-blink-hex/avr-blink-upload targets. New Upload button in examples/editor_main.c's right sidebar (compile_and_upload_avr), mirroring the existing Compile button. Live-verified: parena build -> avr-gcc -> avr-objcopy produces a correct .hex (192 bytes/0.6% of atmega328p), avrdude loads its real config and correctly attempts the real port, failing only at port-open (no physical Arduino in this sandbox). editor-demo builds clean (-Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror). make test: 347/347. PARENA commit 640360b.

⚓ ☃
title: AVR/Arduino native target v0 + editor Upload button
